newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Some rail basis offers tumble.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Some rail basis offers tumble.

text.p: Some soymeal rail offers were slightly lower Monday in response to a lack of activity in cash soymeal markets, U.S. soymeal brokers said.
"It's just real quiet here now," said one dealer. "We saw some end-user pricing on Friday when the market was limit."
On Friday, some nearby soymeal futures closed down the daily $10.00 trading limit, but the market has since recovered on Monday. At 1031 CDT, May soymeal was up $2.00 at $283.50 per ton.
Soymeal exporters said there was little activity on the river.
"It's so thin that the market is hard to call right now," an exporter said.
Several soybean crushers in the eastern Corn Belt were said to be slowing the pace of their crush this week, but that action was described as routine for this time of year.
